name: io.github.kwizzlesurp10-ctrl/apexseo-geo-mcp
title: ApexSEO GEO & AI-Crawler Audit MCP
description: Keyless Base USDC x402 MCP for live AI-crawler, GEO/AEO & JSON-LD citation audits.

tools.name: geo_health
tools.description: Free diagnostic check returning live service uptime, supported AI crawler matrix, x402 payment configuration (Base USDC payTo and CDP facilitator readiness), and SSRF protection status. Call this or geo_pricing first before running paid live-site audits.

tools.name: geo_pricing
tools.description: Free pricing manifest listing all ApexSEO GEO audit endpoints, Base Mainnet (eip155:8453) USDC prices ($0.01-$0.05), endpoint paths, and MCP Streamable HTTP connection details. Ideal sibling to geo_health before dispatching paid calls.

tools.name: ai_crawler_audit
tools.description: Live-fetches a domain's /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /sitemap.xml, and /.well-known/{x402,mcp,agent-card.json} files, returning a per-bot permission matrix (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot, Applebot-Extended, CCBot), AI-crawler readiness score (0-100), and ICE fixes. Use geo_page_audit for HTML/TTFB signals or schema_citation_check for JSON-LD validation.

url.description: Public HTTPS/HTTP URL to audit live (e.g. https://example.com).

tools.name: geo_page_audit
tools.description: Performs a comprehensive live technical + Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) audit of any URL: measures TTFB, redirect chain, X-Robots-Tag, meta robots, canonical/hreflang, compression & security headers, title/meta/OpenGraph, H1-H3 question-heading density, structured lists/tables, empty CSR-shell detection, image alt coverage, E-E-A-T trust signals, composite geoScore (0-100), and ApexSEO Elite ICE action plan. Pair with ai_crawler_audit for site-wide robots.txt/llms.txt or geo_competitor_compare for rival benchmarking.

url.description: Public HTTPS/HTTP URL to audit live (e.g. https://example.com).

tools.name: schema_citation_check
tools.description: Extracts and validates all embedded application/ld+json blocks (including @graph trees) on a live page, flags syntax errors and missing AI-citation properties for Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Product, Article, FAQPage, and WebPage entities, scores schema completeness (0-100), and outputs a ready-to-paste JSON-LD @graph patch customized from detected metadata.

url.description: Public HTTPS/HTTP URL to audit live (e.g. https://example.com).

tools.name: geo_competitor_compare
tools.description: Runs parallel live page GEO audits and AI-crawler (robots.txt / llms.txt) checks across your targetUrl and 1-3 competitorUrls, computing exact win/loss deltas across geoScore, AI-crawler readiness, TTFB speed, schema depth, question headings, and llms.txt coverage, plus a ranked ICE counter-strategy roadmap.

competitorUrls.description: 1 to 3 competitor URLs for live head-to-head benchmarking.
